result.title: Provably Near-Optimal PQ in the Extended Zador Model
result.summary: This paper investigates Product Quantization (PQ) Optimization with Gaussian data. It offers three key contributions (i) a proof that SVD is the optimal preconditioning rotation for PQ; (ii) a new Extended Zador (EZ) estimator of the $k$-means quantization cost that is accurate in low bit rates and low dimensions; and (iii) a novel segmentation algorithm based on 1-d bin packing of global bit allocations. The result is a simple algorithm (EZPQ) with strong approximation guarantees. It matches OPQ's empirical accuracy while providing a per-instance distortion lower bound certificate under the Gaussian EZ cost model. On typical real embedding spectra, EZPQ with 2 bits per coordinate is often certifiably within 1% of the optimum in this model. It also consistently achieves a lower reconstruction error than all random-rotation-based algorithms such as EDEN, E-RaBitQ, and TurboQuant.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究高斯数据下的乘积量化（PQ）优化：证明 SVD 是最优预条件旋转，提出在低码率、低维下更准确的 Extended Zador 量化代价估计，并给出基于一维装箱的全局比特分配切分算法 EZPQ，附带近似保证与逐实例失真下界证书。
